Rough draft - efficient thorough - old with new always. Created Nov 5 2026. For entry-level medical students: how serotypes, acids, channels, pathways, carriers relate. One species = sum of its serotypes.
Core Principle - You Asked For This One Line

The bacterium name appears once, serotype diversity defines its chemical breadth. Same logic: Cryptococcus neoformans/gattii = Σ (serotypes A + B + C + D) = Σ (molecular types VNI + VNII + VNIII + VNIV + VGI + VGII + VGIII + VGIV).
Table 7v2 Main - Cryptococcal GXM Conjugates TT vs DT vs CRM197 (1991-2025 Updated)
Carrier Trinity kept distinct: TT = formaldehyde-detoxified tetanospasmin ~150kDa, DT = chemically detoxified diphtheria toxin, CRM197 = G52E non-toxic mutant (no chemical detox).
Sonicated native serotype A GXM purified
ADH adipic acid dihydrazide hydroxyl GXM-TT2 vs carboxyl GXM-TT1
Hydroxyl more immunogenic than carboxyl; booster IgG/IgM; cross-precip B/C/D
P13 decapeptide mimotope of GXM NOT native
TT P13TT UMass / DT P13DT Sigma SEPARATE
BALB/c vs C57BL/6 chronic 3e4 CFU IP + Alhydrogel
Prolonged survival vs control function strain/carrier/route; passive transfer 1:10 protects naive
Mimotope not native; therapeutic not prophylactic; Th2 IL-10 skew
XenoMouse G2 IgG2 G4 IgG4 human Ig loci subQ Alhydrogel +/- CpG
Both P13-TT and P13-DT antigenic in human Ig mice
Synthetic decasaccharide M2 motif 95% clinical serotype A homogeneous
CRM197 G52E mutant NOT DT avg 4 glycans 60-69kDa
Mice n=5 PBS n=10 IP 10ug CFA d0 IFA d14 d28
Binds EPS like mAb 18B7 competes 18B7/13F1/2D10; IgG1+IgM; weakly opsonic; survival 18 vs 15d p=0.06 NS
Freund's not human-usable; n small; p=0.06
Freund's best opsonic macrophage engulfment + capsule binding mirrored longer survival
N/A LNP platform capsule adjuvant required
CDA1-LNP protected vast majority when coupled capsule adjuvant
Deletion = acapsular avirulent complement activation binding affected
No licensed cryptococcal or fungal vaccine as of 2024-2025. All above preclinical. Freund's adjuvant groups not translatable to humans.
Table 7v2-A - Bacterial-Fungal Bridge - Same Carrier Logic Different Kingdom
Repeat unit per serotype: 19F phosphodiester bridge ManNAc-Glc-Rha-PO4, 6A/6B ribitol-P Gal-Glc-Rha-Ribitol-P SNP wciP 584 Ser vs Asn
GXM mannose backbone xylose glucuronic acid side chains O-acetylated; GXMGal galactan backbone 90% GXM 10% GXMGal
Both use polysaccharide to resist phagocytosis
cps locus dexB-aliA wzx flippase wzy polymerase
CAP10 CAP59 CAP60 CAP64 essential; CAS3 family 6 homologs CAP64-like; CAS1 O-acetyltransferase, CAS2 UXS1 UDP-xylose synthase
Both have capsule assembly genes; homology functional not proven
Serotypes A-D Quellung; molecular VNI-VNIV VGI-VGIV AFLP/MLST
Serotype = chemistry; molecular = genotype; keep separate
GXM alone T-independent; conjugation to TT/DT/CRM197 gives memory IgG class switch
Native GXM alone T-independent; same conjugation converts
Carrier Trinity DT TT CRM197 shared tool not shared biology
Quellung, PCR cpsB, urine antigen (cell wall), culture
CrAg lateral flow assay detects GXM shed in serum/CSF, India ink negative stain, culture
Capsule shed = diagnostic target in both
Table 7v2-B - Acid / Channel / Pathway Communication Map
How acids and sugars talk between pathways.
GXM side chain Crypto; pneumococcal some serotypes
CAS2 UXS1 UDP-xylose synthase precursor for xylose; UDP-glucuronic acid synthesis
Links bacterial rmlABCD rhamnose pathway to fungal xylose addition
GXM side chain, variable substitution defines M1/M2/M4 motifs
Variable substitution = antigenic complexity, like pneumococcal repeat unit branching
Analogous to ManNAc in MenA, GalNAcA in Vi Typhi
GXM mannose O-acetylated; MenA, Vi, 19A etc O-acetyl critical
O-acetyl is epitope determinant; de-O-acetylated GXM loses binding for some sera (GXM-TT1 specificity conferred by O-acetyl)
Single SNP changes linkage = serotype switch; teaching for molecular basis of serotype
Men B/C/W/Y sialic acid alpha2-8 or 2-9; GBS Ia-V sialic acid
Sialic acid capsules mimic host = immune evasion; shared chemistry GBS to Men
Rha synthesis conserved across pneumococcus and Salmonella O-antigen
Table 7v2-C - Carrier Trinity Teaching - TT vs DT vs CRM197 - Manufacturing Not Biology
Formaldehyde-detoxified tetanospasmin, Clostridium tetani tent gene plasmid
Formaldehyde-detoxified diphtheria toxin, Corynebacterium diphtheriae tox gene corynephage beta
Single amino acid mutant G52E of diphtheria toxin, non-toxic without chemical detox, produced in Corynebacterium
Synflorix 18C-TT, MenQuadfi TT, Nimenrix TT, MenAfriVac TT, ActHIB TT, Typbar-TCV Vi-TT
Prevnar 13/20 CRM197, Vaxneuvance CRM197, Pneumosil CRM197, Menveo CRM197, Menjugate CRM197, HbOC CRM197, Vi-CRM investigational, GXM-CRM197 experimental, GBS6 CRM197 investigational
High if many TT conjugates co-administered
Same carrier = same factory tool, not same protection
Same as TT; DT vs CRM197 are different manufacturing even though same toxin origin
Do not call DT = CRM197; keep separate in tables
Table 7v2-D - Entry-Level Clinical Testing Standards Guide (Educational, Not Patient-Specific)
Urine antigen (cell wall polysaccharide), blood culture, CSF culture, Quellung if isolate, PCR lytA cps
Vaccination history PCV13/15/20 PPSV23 determines expected serotype coverage; no serotype cross-protection assumed
CSF Gram stain diplococci, culture, PCR ctrA, latex agglutination for serogroup
MenACWY-TT vs DT vs CRM197 same disease protection but different carrier footprints
Culture, PCR bexA cap b, latex
Hib-TT vs CRM197 vs OMP different carriers same PRP protection
CrAg LFA lateral flow assay serum/CSF detects GXM shed, India ink, culture, opening pressure
GXM capsule shed into host milieu modulates immunity, inhibits phagocytosis
No licensed vaccine; CrAg positivity = capsule production in vivo, correlates with fungal burden; experimental GXM-TT/DT/CRM197 not for clinical use
Blood culture, bone marrow culture, Vi serology limited
Molecular typing MLST, WGS cps locus, AFLP for Crypto VNI-VGIV
Serotype A-D Quellung may not predict VGII outbreak; use molecular for epidemiology
Educational note: No fungal vaccines FDA/EMA approved as of 2024-2025. All cryptococcal vaccines experimental. For medical students: capsule = virulence factor = vaccine target = diagnostic target.
Table 7v2-E - One Bacterium = Sum of Serotypes - Teaching Concept You Stated
Species name appears ONCE; serotype list defines chemical breadth of that one species; 100+ chemistries share core genome dexB-aliA
cps locus recombination, wzy polymerase specificity, wciP SNP 584 changes linkage 6A vs 6B, wciN beta-galactosyltransferase differences
Serotypes share wzx/wzy machinery but make different repeat units; immune response to one does not protect another unless cross-reactive (e.g., 6A/6B partial)
Serogroups A,B,C,W,Y,X = one species; serotype PorB separate axis
sia genes for sialic acid synthesis; capsule switching by recombination
Capsule switching A to W observed post vaccine pressure
Serotypes A-D = one complex; molecular types VNI-VNIV VGI-VGIV = same complex genotyped
CAP genes + CAS family + UXS1 + CAS1 O-acetyl
M2 motif 95% clinical serotype A but M1/M4 cross-reactivity exists; VGII outbreak B MAT alpha immunocompetent shows molecular matters beyond serotype

Teaching mantra: Count the bacterium once. List serotypes as its chemical dialects. Carrier TT/DT/CRM197 is the translator (conjugate) that makes immune system remember a dialect it would otherwise ignore.
Open gaps to close next steps
Add rEPA carrier from 1991 paper as fourth carrier for completeness
Add Pneumosil vs Synflorix Protein D carrier diversity as CIES mitigation example
Add Vi-PS vs Vi-TT vs Vi-CRM comparison as non-pneumococcal conjugate teaching
Build separate GBS Ia-V CRM197 investigational table to show sialic acid parallel
All tables rough draft readable. Ready for your step-by-step edit in Drive.
